# testbed

> Disposable, image-built EC2 boxes that run heavy checks, their Pulumi program, the box agent and the `testbed` CLI (`@figentra/testbed`).

## Docs

- [STATE.md](STATE.md): what is proven, what is not, and the open risks (2026-11-07)
- [README.md](README.md): the CLI verbs, layout and development
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for agents working in this repository
- [Package rules](packages/testbed/AGENTS.md): the package's own agent rules
- [Runbook](docs/runbook.md): how jobs run, replacing a box, rebuilding the image, secrets, cost
- [Specs index](.agents/specs/README.md): STA-1626 and STA-2042, and the old paths they name
- [Agent contract](.agents/specs/sta-1626-testbed/agent-contract.md): the frozen CLI and agent interface
- [Workflows](.github/workflows/README.md): what each workflow does and who may dispatch it

## Entry points

- [Package README](packages/testbed/README.md)
- [CLI](packages/testbed/src/cli/): the `testbed` command
- [Plan](packages/testbed/src/core/): `testbedPlan`, defaults and toolchain pins
- [Pulumi resources](packages/testbed/src/node/): `awsTestbed`
- [Box agent](packages/testbed/src/agent/testbed-agent.sh)
- [Images](packages/testbed/images/): the job image and host image components
- [Pulumi project](packages/testbed/pulumi/)
- [ci-box shim](scripts/ci-box-shim.sh)
- [Apply workflow](.github/workflows/apply-testbed.yml)
- [Test-infra skill](.agents/skills/test-infra/SKILL.md)
